articles.summary: The US government has announced that extensions for H1-B and L-1 visas will require a new fee starting September 9. The move is part of a broader effort to fund the processing of visa applications and improve the efficiency of the country's immigration system.

articles.headline: Greek Island Ithaca Sees Tourism Surge Following Popular Media Series
articles.summary: The Greek island of Ithaca has experienced a significant increase in tourism following the success of a popular media series inspired by Homer's Odyssey. Local businesses have reported record visitor numbers, boosting the island's economy after years of stagnation.

articles.headline: Kalshi Partners with Nasdaq to Enhance Its Trade Surveillance Capabilities
articles.summary: Prediction market platform Kalshi has entered into a partnership with Nasdaq to use its advanced trade surveillance technology. The move aims to improve the integrity of Kalshi's markets and ensure compliance with regulatory standards for financial trading.

articles.headline: Airbus Joins Investigation Into Air India Phuket-Delhi Flight Altitude Plunge
articles.summary: Airbus and French investigators have joined the probe into an Air India A320neo flight's 300-foot plunge near Phuket on August 4. Initially attributed to turbulence, reports now show nine technical failures occurred within one minute, including elevator faults and autopilot disconnect. The incident injured 17 people. The Aircraft Accident Investigation Bureau is leading the inquiry.

articles.headline: Bangladesh Formally Requests India to Expedite Extradition of Former PM Sheikh Hasina
articles.summary: During a meeting with Indian High Commissioner Dinesh Trivedi, Bangladesh Prime Minister Tarique Rahman formally requested the expedited extradition of deposed leader Sheikh Hasina. Dhaka expressed outrage over Hasina's recent political remarks from New Delhi, warning they could undermine bilateral relations. Discussions also focused on creating a conducive environment for future ties.

articles.headline: Vande Mataram to be Sung in Full at 80th Independence Day Celebrations
articles.summary: For the first time, Vande Mataram will be sung in full from the Red Fort to mark the song's 150th anniversary and India's 80th Independence Day. The theme 'Yuva Shakti' focuses on youth's role in achieving 'Viksit Bharat' by 2047. Around 27,000 guests, including farmers and startup founders, will attend the ceremony featuring student achievers and National Cadet Corps volunteers.

articles.headline: Tamil Nadu Assembly Mandates Singing State Anthem at All Official Functions
articles.summary: The Tamil Nadu Assembly unanimously passed a resolution making it mandatory to sing the state anthem, 'Tamil Thai Vaazhthu', at the start of all government, educational, and public sector functions. Moved by CM C. Joseph Vijay, the move aims to preserve the state's cultural and linguistic identity following recent controversies regarding the anthem's performance at official events.

articles.headline: Nine Family Members Killed as Van is Swept Away in Madhya Pradesh
articles.summary: Nine members of a family, including children, died after their van was swept into a flooded drain while crossing an unfinished bridge in Madhya Pradesh's Rajgarh district. The driver reportedly ignored warnings about high water levels. While two people were rescued, the state administration has announced ₹4 lakh compensation for the next of kin of each deceased victim.

articles.headline: Amit Shah to Address Lok Sabha Debate on Student Protests and Police
articles.summary: Home Minister Amit Shah will respond to a Lok Sabha debate regarding recent student protests and police actions. While the government expressed readiness to discuss issues including examination reforms and the Ram Temple, the Opposition demanded clarity on the use of pellet guns. Amid disruptions, the House passed the Tribunals Reforms Bill, 2026, to establish a National Tribunals Commission.

articles.headline: New Bill Introduced to Bar States From Taxing Mineral Rights and Land
articles.summary: The government introduced the Mines and Minerals Amendment Bill, 2026, in the Lok Sabha to prevent state governments from imposing taxes or royalties on mineral-bearing lands. The legislation follows a Supreme Court ruling that upheld states' taxing powers. The move aims to ensure commercial viability and bring uniformity to the mining sector by easing its financial burden.

articles.headline: Supreme Court to Hear Plea Challenging Ram Rahim's 2002 Murder Acquittal
articles.summary: The Supreme Court has agreed to hear a plea challenging the acquittal of Dera Sacha Sauda chief Gurmeet Ram Rahim Singh in the 2002 murder of journalist Ram Chander Chhatrapati. A bench led by Justice Surya Kant issued a notice to the sect leader, who is currently imprisoned for other crimes. The final hearing is scheduled for November to review the Punjab and Haryana High Court's decision.

articles.headline: Vodafone Idea Narrows Q1 Net Loss to ₹3,754 Crore as Revenue Grows
articles.summary: Vodafone Idea reported a narrowed net loss of ₹3,754 crore for the June quarter, supported by a one-time accounting gain of ₹1,611 crore from legal settlements. Revenue from operations rose 6% to ₹11,689 crore, while average revenue per user reached ₹190. The company’s 5G services are live in 200 cities as it continues discussions with lenders to fund network expansion and compete with rivals.

articles.headline: Powerful 7.4 Magnitude Earthquake in Western Colombia Kills Over 100 People
articles.summary: A massive 7.4-magnitude earthquake struck western Colombia, claiming at least 111 lives and injuring hundreds. The quake destroyed more than 4,800 buildings across 20 municipalities, prompting a state of emergency. Tremors were felt as far as Bogota and Venezuela. Rescue teams continue searching for survivors in several cities where significant structural damage and building collapses occurred.

articles.headline: Supreme Court Sets Hearing for Tamil Nadu's Cauvery Water Release Plea
articles.summary: The Supreme Court has scheduled an August 13 hearing for Tamil Nadu's plea seeking the release of 3,500 cusecs of Cauvery water from Karnataka for 15 days. Tamil Nadu reports a shortfall of 26.954 tmc ft and alleges that Karnataka’s non-compliance with water-sharing orders has endangered Samba crops. The state argues that farmers are in a perilous situation due to the lack of irrigation.

articles.headline: Nagaland CM Urges Review of FCRA Amendments Over Impact on Christian Organizations
articles.summary: Nagaland Chief Minister Neiphiu Rio has expressed concerns to Home Minister Amit Shah regarding proposed amendments to the Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Act. Rio warned the changes could negatively impact Christian organizations and social services in the state. He requested that the bill be referred to a joint parliamentary committee for wider stakeholder consultation and a comprehensive review.

articles.headline: Supreme Court Proposes Special Courts for Manipur Ethnic Violence Cases
articles.summary: The Supreme Court has requested the Gauhati High Court to establish special courts for day-to-day hearings of 2023 Manipur ethnic violence cases investigated by the CBI and NIA. The move aims to expedite trials for over 30 cases involving heinous crimes, including sexual assault. Current reports indicate that 891 out of 904 witnesses in CBI cases have yet to be examined by the judiciary.

articles.headline: Centre Achieves 74 Percent of Annual PSU Disinvestment Target
articles.summary: The Indian government has raised ₹59,082.95 crore, nearly three-fourths of its ₹80,000-crore asset-sale target for the current fiscal year. The revenue was primarily driven by offer-for-sale (OFS) transactions in public sector companies, including a 6.5% stake in LIC and holdings in Coal India. The progress puts the Centre on track to meet disinvestment goals that were missed in previous years.

articles.headline: UPI Transactions Will Remain Free for Consumers and Small Merchants
articles.summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman clarified in Parliament that there will be no charges on UPI transactions for consumers or small merchants. Addressing concerns during a debate on the Taxation Bill, she stated UPI remains a public good. While a Merchant Discount Rate may apply to limited high-value categories in the future, everyday payments to vendors will stay free for the public.

articles.headline: India’s Unemployment Rate Stood at 5.4 Percent in April-June Quarter
articles.summary: According to the Periodic Labour Force Survey, India's unemployment rate was 5.4% in the April-June 2026 quarter. While urban unemployment remained stable at 6.7%, the survey highlighted a significant gender disparity, with urban females facing an 8.7% rate compared to 6.1% for males. The report also noted an increase in regular wage jobs and a shift of workers into the secondary sector.

articles.headline: Meta Releases New Muse Glimmer Open-Weight AI Model for Personal Computers
articles.summary: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg has released Muse Glimmer, a new open-weight AI model designed to perform agentic tasks on personal computers and Macs. Optimized for single-graphics-card performance, the model aims to foster innovation and compete with Chinese rivals. Meta plans to spend $145 billion on AI infrastructure this year to maintain its lead in accessible, open-source AI technology.

articles.headline: Jeff Bezos Consortium Nears $1.3 Billion Deal for Liverpool FC Stake
articles.summary: A consortium including Amazon founder Jeff Bezos and Facebook co-founder Eduardo Saverin is reportedly close to acquiring a one-third stake in Liverpool Football Club. Led by Amit Bhatia, the deal values the minority stake at approximately $1.3 billion, with a total club valuation of $5.9 billion. The acquisition would mark a significant entry of US tech billionaires into English football.

articles.headline: Police Clash With Protesters Marching Toward Jharkhand Assembly Over Recruitment
articles.summary: Police used lathi charges, tear gas, and water cannons to disperse thousands of job aspirants marching toward the Jharkhand Assembly in Ranchi. Protesters are demanding the cancellation of the JSSC-CGL 2024 exam and a CBI probe into alleged recruitment irregularities. The clash, which left several injured, occurred as an indefinite strike over the issue entered its 17th day.

articles.headline: FSSAI Seizes 18,000 Boxes of Diageo Liquor Over Labeling Violations
articles.summary: The FSSAI seized approximately 18,000 boxes of liquor, including Smirnoff and VAT 69, from a Diageo India facility in Bengaluru. The seizure, worth $1.6 million, was due to alleged violations regarding mandatory markings for food-grade recycled plastic. Diageo has quarantined the stock and is engaging with regulators, maintaining that the bottles are sourced from approved recyclers and are safe.

articles.headline: Government Clarifies No Overarching Policy Bar on Airport Operators Owning Airlines
articles.summary: The Union government informed the Rajya Sabha that there is no specific national policy preventing airport operators from owning scheduled airlines. However, the Ministry clarified that existing public-private partnership (PPP) agreements at certain major airports contain specific contractual clauses that may limit such cross-ownership. The statement follows speculation regarding the Adani Group.

articles.headline: July E-Way Bill Generation Hits Near-Record 139.8 Million
articles.summary: E-way bill generation rose to 139.8 million in July 2026, marking the second-highest monthly total on record. The 6% year-on-year growth signals sustained momentum in domestic trade and improved tax compliance following GST rate rationalizations. Experts view this high-frequency indicator as a strong proxy for economic activity, likely translating into higher GST collections in coming months.

articles.headline: Parliament Passes Taxation Bill Providing Legal Backing for Free UPI
articles.summary: Parliament has passed the Taxation and Other Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2026, which provides legal backing to ensure UPI transactions remain free for consumers. Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman clarified that the legislation does not impose taxes on digital payments. The bill also includes provisions aimed at attracting foreign capital and easing the relocation of fund managers to India.

articles.headline: CESC to Acquire 1.4 Gigawatt Solar Portfolio From ReNew for ₹4,860 Crore
articles.summary: RP-Sanjiv Goenka Group’s CESC Ltd, through its arm Purvah Green Power, will acquire a 1.4 GWp solar portfolio in Rajasthan and Karnataka from ReNew Solar Power for ₹4,860 crore. Over 90% of the capacity is contracted under long-term agreements with the Solar Energy Corporation of India. The acquisition is part of CESC's strategy to build a 10-gigawatt renewable energy portfolio within two years.

articles.headline: Ukrainian Drone Strike on Russian Oil Refinery Kills 13 People
articles.summary: A Ukrainian long-range drone attack on the Taneco oil refinery and a nearby hostel in Russia’s Tatarstan region killed 13 people and injured 75. The strike on the Nizhnekamsk petroleum hub is part of an ongoing campaign targeting Russian energy infrastructure to disrupt fuel supplies. Local authorities declared a day of mourning as international sanctions complicate repair efforts at the site.

articles.headline: China Condemns India's Move to Formally Name 27 Sites in Arunachal Pradesh
articles.summary: China has condemned India's decision to officially name 27 sites, including mountain passes and lakes, in Arunachal Pradesh. Beijing, which refers to the region as Zangnan, labeled the move "illegal, null and void." India maintains that Arunachal Pradesh is an integral part of its territory and updated its maps with standard names to ensure accurate recognition and push back against claims.
